name: MCP Checkup
description: Look up scheduled check results for public remote MCP servers: availability, protocol handshake and negotiated revision, tool-list and schema drift against an approved baseline, and auth metadata. Results are published as Ed25519-signed DSSE attestations verifiable against https://mcpcheckup.com/.well-known/mcpcheckup-keys.json. Tools: check_mcps, get_mcp_report, get_mcp_history, get_attestation, search_mcps, request_check. No authentication required.
author: MCP Checkup
